name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.173: A direction whose deferred fire is still pending is painted yellow even when
    its last run ended green, and the deferral line under the Workers list appears only while
    the direction is actually stopped. Measured on prod: the download hit its daily limit at
    06:08 leaving 384 of 412 queued items due and armed its fire for 04:37 the next day; it
    then ran normally at 10:30 and 13:50, so its row read ok and the lamp went green while the
    backlog still waited - and the line kept naming that fire as if the direction were stuck.
    Only a green row is overridden: red, grey and running rows keep their own statement. The
    fire itself is never touched - dropping it would leave the due items waiting for the next
    regular anchor.
